in_sanskrit.name: Aryir
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Noble, Exalted One
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Aryir एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'arya' meaning noble or exalted. In Hindu mythology, the term 'Arya' is used to describe a noble, virtuous person. The name Aryir is a rare and beautiful choice for a baby boy in Hindu tradition.
